newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BALTIKA, VIISNURK MARKET MAKERS NAMED.
newsitem.headline: BALTIKA, VIISNURK MARKET MAKERS NAMED.

text.p: The Tallinn stock exchange said that the market makers for Viisnurk's listing on the bourse will be Forekspank, Hansapank and Hoiupank.

The bourse said in statement that until the new share issue is registered, trading of the ski and furniture maker's shares will be done through order books. The minimum amount for trading will be 100 and the price is 0.05 kroons.
The bourse also said that the market makers for Baltika's listing from June 5 will be Forekspank, Hansapank, HF Capital, Hoiupank and ICI Trust.
The minimum amount for trading in the clothing manufacturer and retailer will be 500 and the price is 0.05 kroons.
